types.name: Components of a time series
types.description: Describes a pattern or event in data over time and asks which component (trend, seasonal, cyclical, irregular) it is.

types.name: Additive and multiplicative models
types.description: Asks about the additive or multiplicative model, or combines trend and indices to get a value.

types.name: Method of semi-averages
types.description: Asks for a trend line or trend value using the averages of the two halves of the data.

types.name: Moving averages
types.description: Gives a run of values and asks for a 3-, 4- or 5-period moving average or its centring.

types.name: Least-squares trend line
types.description: Gives a trend equation or data to fit y = a + bx by least squares and asks for a, b or a trend value.

types.name: Seasonal indices
types.description: Asks for a seasonal index, the missing index, adjustment to 400 or 1200, or a deseasonalised value.
